summary: wiring_class::signals() false positives for derived: BONUS:STAT|<ABILITY>|<value> fields trip SCALARS_WORD via the STAT selector token (STR/DEX/CON/INT/WIS/CHA) regardless of whether <value> is scalar-dependent, and has_arith's unconditional value.contains('/') fires on PCGen's literal DR:/CR: bypass-type notation (e.g. DR:10/Cold Iron, CR:1/3). 3 of 150 SD31-E2-F1 sampled units show this as a clean single-cause misclassification (core_rulebook:race_trait:2_dexterity, ultimate_equipment:equipment:staff_of_mithral_might, bestiary:monster:neothelid -- all engine=derived, true=static). See SD31-E2-F1-ground-truth-methodology.md Finding B.
